html:
The Maclaurin expansion of ex is

ex=1+x+x22!+x33!+x44!+⋯.

Replacing x with x2, we get

ex2=1+(x2)+(x2)22!+(x2)33!+(x2)44!+⋯=1+x2+x42+x66+x824+⋯.

Similarly, replacing x with −x2, we get

e−x2=1+(−x2)+(−x2)22!+(−x2)33!+(−x2)44!+⋯=1−x2+x42−x66+x824+⋯.

Taking the difference of the expansions for ex2 and e−x2, we get

ex2−e−x2=(1+x2+x42+x66+x824+⋯)−(1−x2+x42−x66+x824+⋯)=(1−1)+(1+1)x2+(12−12)x4+(16+16)x6+(124−124)x8+⋯=2x2+x63+⋯.
